themeMechanism.notes: useEffect on mount: saved theme wins; else system dark preference adds .dark; toggle writes localStorage and toggles class. No theme provider, no context; component-local useState. Default state before effect runs is 'light'.

samples: L64: <span className={`${isMobile ? 'text-[12px]' : 'text-[14.4px]'} font-medium mt-1 text-[#9CA3AF] dark:text-[#A3A3B3]`}>
